data: Which line has the lowest value at the point where the x-axis is 17?

The question asks for the line with the lowest value at the point where the x-axis is 17. From the caption, we know there are five lines in the figure representing different models. The x-axis represents the number of sentences by length, and the y-axis represents BLEU scores. At x=17, the line corresponding to the Enc-Dec 4 layers model appears to be the lowest among all the lines. Therefore, the answer is the Enc-Dec 4 layers model.
